checks.check: Two-pane responsive list/draft layout, explicit root/scope/filter/counts and all error/empty/recovery states.
checks.evidence: renderer.ts: `.manager{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px}` with a `.detail` (registration) section followed by a `.list` section — a documented, user-authorized change from the original side-by-side two-pane grid to a stacked 'registration above list' layout at every width (docs/epics/.../S005/UI-FEEDBACK.md: 'The user explicitly replaced the old two-pane layout with registration above list... at all widths and in DOM/keyboard order'). host.test.ts's new fifth case asserts `html.indexOf('<section class="detail"')<html.indexOf('<section class="list"')`. Explicit controls are present: #root select, #scope select, filter-all/saved/temporary buttons showing counts, #counts text. CONNECTION_MANAGER_SCRIPT's `statuses` map covers loading/ready/empty-registry/empty-filter/read-error/offline/no-repository/upgrade-required, and the third host.test.ts case iterates every ConnectionListState asserting `#list-status` is populated and `#error` stays clear. Functional intent (two labeled sections, responsive at narrow width via the `@media(max-width:760px)` rule, explicit root/scope/filter/counts, all states) is met even though the literal 'two-pane' (side-by-side) wording is superseded by the authorized layout correction.

checks.check: Strict allowlisted webview intent messages, CSP/escaping, no raw capabilities/config/secret persistence via setState or generic RPC bridge.
checks.evidence: types.ts `parseConnectionIntent` enumerates exact `type` values and required field sets, rejecting any extra key via `Object.keys(o).length!==expected.length`. host.test.ts's second test feeds rpc/ticket/capability/accessor-getter/stale-protocol/path-prototype payloads and asserts each parses to null, and that no getter was invoked (`getters===0`). CSP meta is `default-src 'none'; script-src 'nonce-...'; connect-src 'none'; img-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'`, and the same test asserts CONNECTION_MANAGER_SCRIPT does not match `/innerHTML|setState|getState|localStorage|sessionStorage|fetch\(|XMLHttpRequest|eval\(/`. The script only ever calls `api.postMessage` (no `vscode.setState`), matching the no-generic-RPC/no-persistence requirement.

checks.check: Accessible labels/focus-visible/status region; masked replacement fields; dirty close/hide handled without ending owner.
checks.evidence: CSS has `:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--vscode-focusBorder);outline-offset:2px}`, asserted present by test 2. Every input uses the `label()` helper tying `<label for>` to its id; #error/#notice/#list-status/#test-status carry role=alert|status with aria-live. The toolbar-icon test confirms close/add/refresh/previous/next/remove each has aria-label + title + an aria-hidden, non-focusable SVG. Credential replacement inputs are type=password and start blank (`assert.equal(secret.value,'')`); three distinct secret values are asserted never to appear in any panel.posts. Hiding the panel clears password inputs (`dom.hide()` then `assert.equal(secret.value,'')`) and the owner stays `'ready'`; closing with a dirty draft shows the confirm dialog (`panel.view.dirty===true`) and only disposes after explicit confirm, again with owner status unaffected throughout.

verdict.reason: host.ts/renderer.ts/types.ts (committed at 63966e4ad, matching TESTS.md's t18 record) implement the injected-ports webview host with a strict intent allowlist, CSP/escaping, no setState/RPC bridge, and accessible/masked/dirty-safe behavior; the only literal mismatch — 'two-pane' vs. the now-stacked layout — is an explicitly authorized correction documented in UI-FEEDBACK.md, not a defect. The daemon's typecheck and the named integration test (plus its four sibling cases) pass with real VM-executed DOM assertions, and the current uncommitted working-tree changes (chat-panel, mocks) are unrelated follow-on work outside this Task's files.
